verdict.rationale: Zamzar's evidence shows only a point-and-click web UI (pick files, choose a format) and a REST API/SDK driven by structured requests to the jobs endpoint. Nothing documents a natural-language command interface. 'MP3 to Text' is a conversion type, not a way of operating the product, and the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes returned 404. A natural-language interface is a plausible capability for a SaaS conversion service, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
